regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. The section adds four words to the baseline count, all from the two em dash repairs, and the surplus is named in the generation reasoning. The finding worth carrying is that a heading rename and a one-word deletion in the prose beneath it moved the same claim in the same direction, and only one of the two is visible to the structural hold. A pass that renames a heading toward completeness will tend to remove the hedges in the prose that contradicted the new heading, and the second half of that is invisible to every gate the repository runs.
